categories.name: Privacy preferences
categories.description: What agents may and may not do

memories.title: Answer briefly, then offer detail
memories.body: Lead with the answer in one or two sentences. Offer the longer explanation only if I ask for it.

memories.title: British spelling in writing
memories.body: Use British spelling (colour, organise) in anything I'll publish. Code identifiers stay American.

memories.title: No emoji in commit messages
memories.body: Commit messages: imperative mood, no emoji, a blank line before the body.

memories.title: Swift 6 with strict concurrency
memories.body: New Swift code uses Swift 6 language mode with strict concurrency. Prefer actors and Sendable value types over locks.

memories.title: Tests use Swift Testing
memories.body: Write new tests with Swift Testing (@Test, #expect). Keep XCTest only for UI tests.

memories.title: Prefer SQLite over Core Data
memories.body: For local storage I reach for SQLite (GRDB on the Mac) rather than Core Data: easier to inspect and migrate.

memories.title: Garden planner app
memories.body: Side project: an iPhone app that plans which vegetables to sow each week, from the last frost date. SwiftUI, no account, data stays on the phone.

memories.title: Garden planner: next milestone
memories.body: Next milestone is the sowing calendar view. Beta to friends by the end of the month.

memories.title: Team uses trunk-based development
memories.body: At work we merge small changes to main several times a day, behind feature flags. No long-lived branches.

memories.title: Never share client names
memories.body: Agents may help with client work, but client names stay out of anything that leaves my Mac.

memories.title: Ask before sending email
memories.body: Draft emails for me, but never send one without showing me the final text first.

memories.title: Vegetarian, eats fish
memories.body: Pescatarian: no meat, fish is fine. Suggest recipes accordingly.

memories.title: Mornings are for deep work
memories.body: Keep 8:00 to 11:00 free of meetings when suggesting times.

memories.title: Prefers trains to short flights
memories.body: For trips under five hours by rail, suggest the train first.

memories.title: Running three times a week
memories.body: Training for a 10 km race: runs on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday mornings.

memories.title: Allergic to penicillin
memories.body: Penicillin allergy. Mention it whenever medication comes up.

memories.title: Monthly budget review
memories.body: Budget review on the first Sunday of each month. Categories only; never ask for account numbers.

memories.title: Flat lease renews in March
memories.body: The flat's lease renews on 1 March; notice is due two months before.

memories.title: Conference talk accepted
memories.body: My talk on local-first apps was accepted for the autumn conference. Slides due three weeks before.

memories.title: Reading list: systems design
memories.body: Currently reading a book on data-intensive applications, chapter 7 (transactions).

memories.title: Old phone number
memories.body: Replaced: the old work phone number is no longer in use.

memories.title: Tabs, not spaces
memories.body: Outdated: the team switched to four spaces.

inbox.title: Uses Xcode Cloud for CI
inbox.body: The garden planner app builds and tests on Xcode Cloud on every push to main.
inbox.evidence: Read from the project's ci_scripts folder.
inbox.purpose: So future sessions know how the app is built.

inbox.title: Mornings are for deep work
inbox.body: Keep 8:00 to 11:30 free of meetings when suggesting times.
inbox.evidence: You moved this week's stand-up to 11:30.

inbox.title: Book the dentist
inbox.body: Book a dentist check-up before the end of the year.

approvals.task: Set up the test target for the garden planner app

save.title: Calendar weeks start on Monday
save.body: In the garden planner, calendar weeks start on Monday, whatever the phone's region says.
save.evidence: You changed firstWeekday to 2 in the calendar view.
save.purpose: To keep the calendar consistent in later edits.
